div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div: Player
[Person]

A player using the phone,
either against the AI or in
pass-and-play mode.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div: Mobile OS
[Software System]

iOS or Android services for
lifecycle, local storage,
audio output, and the
graphics device.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div: Mobile app shell and match coordinator
[Container: TypeScript / React Native / Expo]

Owns navigation, input
routing, phase presentation,
event fan-out, and app
lifecycle.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div: Headless rules engine
[Container: TypeScript, pure module]

Owns the match state machine,
command validation, rules,
damage cascade, repair, and
domain events.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div: AI policy
[Container: TypeScript, seeded policy module]

Chooses fair RPS throws and
legal actions for Easy and
Standard difficulty.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.div: Fire minigame controller
[Container: TypeScript / React Native]

Runs the crosshair
interaction and maps aim
against versioned tuning data
to miss, hit, or center-hit.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div: 3D renderer
[Container: React Native + react-three-fiber + Three.js + Expo GL]

Renders the battlefield and
consumes snapshots and events
for projectile, shatter,
camera, and hand animations.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div: Audio and effects adapter
[Container: Expo-compatible audio/effects adapter]

Subscribes to domain events
and plays the small MVP SFX
set.

div.style: color: rgb(255, 255, 255) !important; display: table; white-space: break-spaces; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center; width: 200px;

span.div: Local match save store
[Container: AsyncStorage-compatible local store]

Stores a versioned, resumable
match snapshot and settings.
No server synchronization.
